raw_definitions: Definisi : knock for ~, (act.) benar-benar mengejutkan; (pass.) benar-benar terkejut: he thought he had not done well in the exam, and he was knocked for ~ when they said he had come out tops, fikirnya dia tdk dapat menjawab dgn baik dlm peperiksaan, jadi dia benar-benar terkejut apabila mereka mengatakan yg dia mendapat keputusan yg terbaik. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : at ~es and sevens, (colloq) a. in disorder, kelam-kabut: my secretary is on holiday and my office is at ~es and sevens, setiausaha saya sedang bercuti, dan pejabat saya sekarang kelam-kabut; b. undecided, confused, bingung; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : ~ of one and half a dozen of the other, (colloq) kedua-duanya sama saja: I don’t care if we go for a drive or see a movie. It’s ~ of one and half a dozen of the other, saya tak kisah sama ada hendak pergi berjalan-jalan atau tengok wayang. Kedua-duanya sama saja; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : adj enam; (denoting particular member of a class) enam (approp classifier): a ~-cylinder engine, enjin enam silinder; there are ~ chairs to a row, ada enam buah kerusi dlm satu baris; the couple has ~ children, pasangan itu mempunyai enam orang anak; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. (number), (nombor, angka) enam: draw the figure ~ on the card, lukiskan angka enam pd kad itu; 2. (size) saiz enam; 3. six o’clock, /pukul, jam/ enam: he arrived at 6 p.m., dia sampai pd pukul 6 petang; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
